question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int main() {
int a = 10, b = 20;
int *p, *q;

p = &a;
q = &b;

*p = *p + 5;
*q = *p + *q;
p = q;
*p = *p - 10;

printf("%d %d", a, b);

return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{15\ 25}$
     
  2. $\texttt{15\ 35}$
     
  3. $\texttt{10\ 25}$
     
  4. $\texttt{25\ 15}$
question.subject: Programming in C

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int main() {
    int i, j, count = 0;

    for (i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
        for (j = 1; j <= 4; j++) {
            if (i == j)
                continue;

            if (i + j > 5)
                break;

            count++;
        }
    }

    printf("%d", count);
    return 0;
}

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int main() {
    int a[5] = {2, 4, 1, 3, 5};
    int i, sum = 0;

    for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0)
            sum = sum + a[i];
        else {
            sum = sum + i;

            if (sum > 8)
                break;
        }
    }

    printf("%d %d", i, sum);
    return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{3\ 11}$
     
  2. $\texttt{4\ 16}$
     
  3. $\texttt{5\ 16}$
     
  4. $\texttt{2\ 8}$

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int update(int x) {
    x = x + 3;
    return x * 2;
}

int main() {
    int a = 4, b;

    b = update(a);
    printf("%d %d", a, b);

    return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{7\ 14}$
     
  2. $\texttt{4\ 14}$
     
  3. $\texttt{4\ 8}$
     
  4. $\texttt{7\ 8}$

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int main() {
    int x = 3, y = 1;

    switch (x - 1) {
        case 1:
            y = y + 2;
        case 2:
            y = y * 3;
        case 3:
            y = y - 1;
            break;
        default:
            y = y + 5;
    }

    printf("%d", y);
    return 0;
}
